enabled.title: Show Seasons
enabled.desc: Turns every effect on the site on or off.

schedule.title: When
schedule.desc: Always, only in winter (15 November – 31 January) or between two dates.

endDate.title: Until
endDate.desc: Month and day, e.g. 01-15. May be in the next year.

excludedPaths.title: Pages without effects
excludedPaths.desc: One path per line; a page and everything under it. Use * as a wildcard, e.g. /store/* or */checkout.

source.title: Weather source
source.desc: Pick one weather, follow the weather outside, change it at random every 3 hours or follow the season.

weather.title: Weather
weather.desc: The effect that shows on the site.

randomPool.title: Weathers to pick from
randomPool.desc: Random weather picks only from these.

city.title: City
city.desc: The weather outside comes from this city; its hemisphere sets the seasons.

heavySnow.title: Heavy snow
heavySnow.desc: A full blizzard instead of gentle flurries.

wind.title: Wind
wind.desc: Blows everything that falls to one side.

settle.title: Snow settles on the page
settle.desc: Snow piles up on cards, the menu bar and the footer.

groundSnow.title: Snow at the bottom
groundSnow.desc: Snow piles up along the bottom edge of the window.

pileSpeed.title: Pile up speed
pileSpeed.desc: How fast the snow piles up.

surfaces.title: Extra snowy elements
surfaces.desc: CSS selector of more elements snow settles on.

excludeSurfaces.title: Snow-free elements
excludeSurfaces.desc: CSS selector of elements snow never settles on. data-no-snow works too.

snowballs.title: Snowballs
snowballs.desc: Visitors roll snowballs through deep snow, grab and throw them.

snowmen.title: Snowmen
snowmen.desc: Three stacked snowballs become a snowman.

dressUp.title: Dress up snowmen
dressUp.desc: Hats, scarves, faces and more for every snowman.

decorations.title: Decorations
decorations.desc: String lights, candles, baubles and more, placed anywhere.

maxPlaced.title: Most trees and decorations
maxPlaced.desc: How many of each one visitor may place.

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.desc: Characters drop by while it snows.

snowmenFight.title: Grumpy snowmen
snowmenFight.desc: Two snowmen have a snowball fight.

yeti.title: Yeti
yeti.desc: The yeti stomps through and knocks a snowman over.

plough.title: Snowplough
plough.desc: The snowplough clears the snow at the bottom.

layer.title: Layer
layer.desc: The weather falls over the page or behind its content.

wallpaper.title: Matching wallpaper
wallpaper.desc: Replaces the page background with the weather's wallpaper.

wallpaperDayNight.title: Follow the time of day
wallpaperDayNight.desc: The wallpaper goes from morning to a starry night with the visitor's clock.

panel.title: Show in the panel
panel.desc: The weather falls in the admin panel too.

panelAmount.title: Amount in the panel
panelAmount.desc: How much falls and piles up in the panel, compared with the site.

mobile.title: Phones and tablets
mobile.desc: Show the effects on touch devices too.

reducedMotion.title: Respect reduced motion
reducedMotion.desc: Show nothing to visitors whose system asks for less motion.

visitorControls.title: Visitor button
visitorControls.desc: A small button lets visitors turn the weather off and plant trees or decorations.

city.credit: Weather data by Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0). Pano asks it; visitors' browsers never do.

controls.title: Weather
controls.trees-full: That is enough trees for this page.
controls.decor-full: That is enough decorations for this page.

trees.title: Christmas tree
trees.full: That is enough trees for this page. Take one down to plant another.

MANAGE_SEASONS.title: Manage Seasons
MANAGE_SEASONS.description: Can change the weather effects of the site.
